titulo: A bakery's website, before and after
hooks: Does your website make people hungry, or sad?
voz: Pixelated counter photos, a menu you can't read and no hours or address in sight. That's how a lot of bakery websites look on a phone. The new version has photos that make you hungry, today's bread right at the top and a button to order ahead.
captions: Your website is the shop window people look at from their phone. If the photos are blurry and your hours don't show up, nobody comes in to ask.
A bakery sells with the eyes. Photos that make people hungry, today's bread front and center and a button to order: that's enough to get picked.
What time do you open? Do you take custom cake orders? If your website answers that, you save yourself a ton of messages.
